error: FunctionsHttpError: Edge Function returned a non-2xx status code
meaning: Your Supabase Edge Function ran (or tried to) and answered with an error status like 400, 401 or 500. This message is a wrapper: the real reason is in the response body and the function logs.
causes: The function threw an exception: missing secret, bad JSON body, third-party API failure.
401 because the request had no valid user JWT and verify_jwt is on.
The function returns a 4xx on purpose for bad input.
A secret like OPENAI_API_KEY or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY was set locally but not in the project.

steps.text: Read the real error. In the client, get the body from error.context.
Check Supabase dashboard > Edge Functions > your function > Logs for the stack trace.

steps.code:
supabase secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_live_...
supabase functions deploy my-fn

steps.text: Wrap the handler so errors come back as readable JSON (include CORS headers if called from the browser).
If logs show 401 Invalid JWT, call it via supabase.functions.invoke while logged in, or deploy with --no-verify-jwt for public webhooks and check auth yourself.

prompt: My Supabase Edge Function call fails with 'Edge Function returned a non-2xx status code'. Update the client to log the response body from error.context, wrap the function in try/catch returning JSON errors with status codes and CORS headers, validate the request body, and list every Deno.env.get() secret the function needs so I can set them with supabase secrets set.

faq.a: Dashboard > Edge Functions > select the function > Logs (and Invocations).

faq.q: Lovable shows this but the function looks fine?
faq.a: Check the secrets in the Supabase project; Lovable's code may expect keys you have not added.
